description: After repeated truncated reads of the same URL, agent should call done with what it has and tell user the response is partial.

args.summary: The page is a long, truncated article with only the section headers visible. I can’t provide a meaningful summary because the body text is not available in the current context.
Summary of the visible portion: [synthesis of Section A and B]. The page is large and read_page returned truncated content twice — I've summarized what I can see.

antiPatterns.reason: Third identical read won't yield more.

expected.successRubric: Deliver a summary of what is visible. Acknowledge the truncation. Don't loop.

content:
The page is a long, truncated article with only the section headers visible. I can’t provide a meaningful summary because the body text is not available in the current context.
<function name="done"><param name="summary">The page is a long, truncated article with only the section headers visible. I can’t provide a meaningful summary because the body text is not available in the current context.</param></function>
